description: The 7 valid Workday customer groups. Two jobs: assignment='selectable' lists what a user may pick as an extra group; assignment='auto_band' rows carry the first_char_from/first_char_to boundaries a transform bands the customer name with (is_fallback='Y' when the first character is outside every band). The band boundaries live here, in config, so they are not hard-coded in a CASE the way workday_customer_groups.sql does it.
provenance: Transcribed 2026-07-15 from the Customer EIB's Default_Customer_Group named range ('Customer Specific Named Ranges'!C, FA E2E Customers V1.xlsm). A snapshot, not a link. NOT the migration's 5 distinct output values — the two 'Experiences by Wembley' groups are valid but appear on zero migrated rows.
